defects: Composition order is reversed relative to the gold: gold composes the immersion AFTER f (φ ∘ f, with φ's immersion hypothesis at the point f x), while the produced statement composes the immersion BEFORE f (f ∘ g, with g mapping into the domain of f). This is not just a cosmetic rearrangement — it changes the mathematical content and makes the statement false in general (e.g. M=ℝ², M'=ℝ, f(x,y)=|y| is continuous at (0,0) but not smooth there; g(t)=(t,0) is a smooth immersion with f∘g ≡ 0 smooth, giving a counterexample to the claimed iff).
Restricts to C^∞ (`Smooth`/`SmoothAt`) instead of the general C^n regularity parameter `n : ℕ∞ω` used in the gold, losing generality.

Strengthens the immersion hypothesis from a purely local condition (IsImmersionAt at the single point f x) to a global one: g is required to be smooth everywhere (`Smooth I'' I g`) and to have injective mfderiv at every point, rather than merely being a C^n immersion at one point.
Introduces an extra hypothesis `hx : g x'' = x` linking a separate point x'' to x, reflecting the reversed composition structure rather than the gold's direct evaluation of φ at f x.
As a consequence of the above, the produced statement is not an equivalent restatement of the gold theorem; it asserts a different (and generally false) proposition.
